issue: Real 51 s WhatsApp voice note (Best Accuracy, 1 speaker, English, GPU) produced 'so, so, so…' (32x) and 'm m m…' (85x) after the last real words of two clips.
rootCause: Transformers.js generate() keeps stepping rows that already emitted <|endoftext|> until the whole batch is done (no padding of finished rows). decodeBatch decoded every token after the prompt with skip_special_tokens, so whatever whisper-large-v3-turbo produced AFTER its end-of-text became transcript. Present since Phase 1 (batch_decode of whole rows); exposed when commit 77684ec (diarization fixes) merged the one-speaker audio into 22.9 s + 25 s turns batched together with a 1.1 s clip.
